fixes: Posts: concept (sheet #5 and lookbook 04) has stubby fat posts about the same girth as the pipe, 2-3 node bands, flat-sawn tops, pipe resting at about 60-70 percent of post height. Render has two thin ~60 mm poles ~1.5 m tall that stand far above the pipe. Cut posts to pipe height + 0.15-0.25 m, thicken to 80-100 mm (about 1.0-1.2x pipe diameter), add 2-3 node rings each.

Pipe body and lashing: the rear third of the pipe reads as a crumpled paper bundle (torn, flared, rumpled lashings at the post). Concept is a clean cylinder with node rings, a straight sawn cut at the spout end, and two tidy rope wraps of ~25-40 mm width with a visible tail. Replace the lashing ribbons with 4-6 tight rope turns (torus-like, 6 mm cord) and stop the bulging/flaring of the pipe wall.

Pipe slope and mouth: the spout end must be an open, slightly angled saw-cut with a visible hollow (inner wall, 5 mm thickness) and sit 8-12 cm beyond the front post, tilting 5-8 degrees down. Currently the mouth is a closed-looking wedge and the stream leaves from a point lower than the tip. Make the interior visible so water leaves the lip.

Cross-rail: the lower rail is a thin stick lashed on one side only. Concept's second element is a horizontal rail across both posts at ~60 percent height with both ends lashed. Make it the same diameter as the pipe (0.6-0.8x), lashed at both posts, and remove the obvious tilt (it reads as a ladder rung gone wrong).

LOD2/LOD3: the post pair and pipe survive at 78/26 tris, but the silhouettes at switch distance (16 m / 44 m) are a single thin line; the pipe is not visible. Widen LOD2/3 pipe (R already x1.2/1.35, aim x1.8/2.5) and keep the 2 posts separated so the tall H gate shape stays. Also re-frame sheet.jpg: it is shot edge-on and the asset is a speck, so the sheet cannot be judged.

Variation: all three seeds are the same layout (two posts, rail, pipe at the top) with 0.1-0.2 m length changes. Make seeds differ: one single-post (side-mounted, pipe cantilevered), one with a 1.4-1.8 m pipe on a lower, wider two-post frame, one with a drop of 0.3 m and a pipe lashed on top of the posts like the lookbook 04 horizontal run.
library_issues: bamboo reads as pale tan wood with a smooth sheen; concept bamboo is deep golden-olive with dark node rings (colour is a library matter, nodes need a darker band mask).
rope reads as the same colour as bamboo; needs darker hemp-brown so the lashings separate.
basalt rock ring around the pool is foil-like (noted, library).
summary: Identifiable as a bamboo spout on two posts and the 3/4 canonical is pleasant, but the posts are far too tall and thin, the lashings look like crumpled paper, and the pipe is too short and light against the concept's heavy horizontal run over a pool. LOD2/3 collapse to a line; seeds barely differ.
